meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, Mark all mandatory: the vendor accepts both clauses

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow with its default Auction stage.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply an Auction template before adding line items.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the item.

args.goal: on the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", verify both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", and click Done; stop on the completed Auction create screen

steps.note: Configure and verify the two mandatory clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA test vendor to represent Vendor A without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Have the vendor accept the first mandatory clause.
Have the vendor accept the second mandatory clause.
Submit a quote of 100 for the auction line after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the bid submission.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-side confirmation that bidding vendors accepted the Terms and Conditions.
